Study.Name: Daily Stress and Affect in College Students
authors: Sarah M. Thompson, David L. Rivera, Kenji A. Watanabe
abstract: This study investigated daily fluctuations in stress, affect, and sleep quality among undergraduate students during the academic semester.

question.Question.Long.Name: Perceived Stress Item 1
question.Question.Text: How stressed have you felt in the past hour?
question.Question.Description: A self-report measure of momentary perceived stress on a scale from 0 (not at all) to 100 (extremely stressed).
question.Question.Type.Display.Name: digital slider
question.Unique.Timing: Delivered once per day at 8:00 AM

question.Question.Long.Name: Positive Affect Item 1
question.Question.Text: How positive do you feel right now?
question.Question.Description: A self-report measure of momentary positive affect on a visual analog scale from 0 (not at all) to 100 (extremely positive).
question.Question.Type.Display.Name: digital slider
question.Unique.Timing: Delivered once per day at 8:00 AM following stress item

question.Question.Long.Name: Sleep Duration Item 1
question.Question.Text: How many hours did you sleep last night?
question.Question.Description: Self-reported sleep duration in hours for the previous night.
question.Question.Type.Display.Name: number input
question.Unique.Timing: Delivered once per day at 8:00 AM

question.Question.Long.Name: Energy Level Item 1
question.Question.Text: How energetic do you feel right now?
question.Question.Description: A self-report measure of momentary energy level on a scale from 0 (not at all) to 100 (extremely energetic).
question.Question.Type.Display.Name: digital slider
question.Unique.Timing: Delivered once per day at 8:00 AM

question.Question.Long.Name: Social Connectedness Item 1
question.Question.Text: How connected do you feel to others today?
question.Question.Description: A self-report measure of perceived social connectedness on a scale from 0 (not at all) to 100 (extremely connected).
question.Question.Type.Display.Name: digital slider
question.Unique.Timing: Delivered once per day at 8:00 AM

responseKey.question: stress_q1
responseKey.definition: 0 = Not at all stressed, 100 = Extremely stressed

responseKey.question: mood_q1
responseKey.definition: 0 = Not at all positive, 100 = Extremely positive

responseKey.question: sleep_q1

responseKey.question: energy_q1

responseKey.question: social_q1
responseKey.definition: 0 = Not at all connected, 100 = Extremely connected
